   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 17:31:29 +0100</pubDate>
   <description>The stakes for the EU budget have risen sharply as the German chancellor ties the deal to approving an additional €45 billion for Kyiv. "Supporting Ukraine is a matter of our indivisible European security," Merz said in a letter to Council President Antonio Costa.</description>

   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 17:28:06 +0100</pubDate>
   <description>The IIHF has moved Norway, ranked 10th, to Division 1A to free a place for Russia at the tournament in Alberta, after the Court of Arbitration for Sport ordered Russian teams reinstated. The change is not yet confirmed, and Russia has not been guaranteed Canadian visas.</description>

      <title>Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/egypt-two-trains-deadly-collision</link>
      <description><p>President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision in al-Ayyat about 50km from Cairo</p><p>Seven people were killed and at least 125 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said.</p><p>The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 50km (30 miles) south of Cairo, when a train travelling to Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the transport ministry.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/egypt-two-trains-deadly-collision">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Kenyan doomsday sect leader jailed for 200 years for murder of 190 children</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie</link>
      <description><p>Paul Mackenzie convicted over deaths of children and one adult after followers were ordered to starve themselves and their families</p><p>The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history.</p><p>The sentence, comprising 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/19/kenya-starvation-cult-leader-guilty-murder-190-children">found the cult leader guilty</a> of the crimes.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections</link>
      <description><p>Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result</p><p>The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.</p><p>Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994. High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/anc-south-africa-local-elections-water-outages-power-cuts">voters turning away from the party</a>.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Patient is ⁠in ​stable condition and will be transferred to a specialist ‘high consequence’ infectious disease unit</p><p>A British healthcare worker with Ebola is being evacuated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the UK for medical treatment, it has been confirmed.</p><p>“A British citizen currently in the DR Congo has tested positive for Ebola,” a spokesperson for the UK government said in a statement on Wednesday. “The UK has well-established procedures for dealing with cases like this, and those processes have been activated … The risk to the UK public from Ebola remains low.”</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/british-healthcare-worker-ebola-evacuated-drc-to-uk-document-shows">Continue reading...</a></description>

News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America</description><link>https://www.france24.com/en/</link><lastBuildDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:48:45 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.france24.com/en/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category></category><title>French PM brings forward hike in minimum wage to calm protesters</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261109-french-pm-brings-forward-hike-in-minimum-wage-to-calm-protesters</link><description>
French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said ​on Monday, November 9, he was bringing forward a planned hike in the minimum wage to December from January, as he sought to defuse a cost-of-living crisis that has sparked some of France's worst civil unrest in years. Unions swiftly dismissed the offer as "crumbs".
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/068341e0-dc5c-11f1-bfb5-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-5c68cb31.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/068341e0-dc5c-11f1-bfb5-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-5c68cb31.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b69f81e4-dc5a-11f1-b0d2-d9856f8454a6</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:47:54 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Nvidia shares tumble after spy probe announced</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261109-nvidia-shares-tumble-after-spy-probe-announced</link><description>
Shares of artificial intelligence leader Nvidia tumbled early Monday after the chip company said it launched an investigation of CEO Jensen Huang following reports he was targeted by Chinese intelligence. Nvidia shares were down more than eight percent in opening trading after its board announced that a committee of independent directors assisted by outside counsel would undertake the probe.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/bfd386b6-dc5a-11f1-81dc-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-1cc6b77f.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/bfd386b6-dc5a-11f1-81dc-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-1cc6b77f.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">e5099264-dc59-11f1-8c4e-13773f08eafa</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:47:19 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><title>🔴 Iran's Revolutionary Guards behind cyberattacks on supermarket fridges, says French FM</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261109-iran-revolutionary-guards-behind-cyberattacks-on-supermarket-fridges-says-french-fm-barrot</link><description></description><guid isPermaLink="false">bf806312-dc5c-11f1-a860-e3b62a32bd58</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:44:44 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Russell Brand sentenced to 10-and-a-half years in jail for rape, sexual assault</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261109-russell-brand-sentenced-to-10-and-a-half-years-in-jail-for-rape-sexual-assault</link><description>
British comedian Russell Brand, once one of the country's most high-profile broadcasters and a Hollywood star, was jailed for 10-and-a-half years on Monday after he was convicted of raping one woman and sexually assaulting three others around two decades ago.  The judge said ‌Brand was a sexual predator who believed "fame meant you could act how you liked, when you liked, unhindered by the rules ⁠by which decent people live".
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9bb8b612-dc59-11f1-85fd-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261109-170739-171027-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9bb8b612-dc59-11f1-85fd-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261109-170739-171027-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">a104fe0a-dc59-11f1-99ed-95ba7eb88bfa</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:43:39 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>Iran's Revolutionary Guards behind cyberattacks on supermarket fridges, says French FM</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261109-iran-revolutionary-guards-behind-cyberattacks-on-supermarket-fridges-says-french-fm-barrot</link><description>
French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot on Monday accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of being behind a recent cyberattack on French supermarket fridges, saying there would be consequences for the country. The Paris prosecutor's office said it had opened an investigation into an Iranian cyber unit affiliated with the Guards over the cyberattacks.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0636c77c-dc5a-11f1-8ea2-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-02T120847Z-783564320-RC2NFOAQZL7Z-RTRMADP-3-EUROPE-CYBERATTACK.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0636c77c-dc5a-11f1-8ea2-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-02T120847Z-783564320-RC2NFOAQZL7Z-RTRMADP-3-EUROPE-CYBERATTACK.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ecd686ae-dc5a-11f1-99f4-e15886b57e2b</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:42:07 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0636c77c-dc5a-11f1-8ea2-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-02T120847Z-783564320-RC2NFOAQZL7Z-RTRMADP-3-EUROPE-CYBERATTACK.jpg">© Stephanie Lecocq, Reuters</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

<![CDATA[ Latest from Space.com ]]> https://www.space.com/feeds.xml Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:00:00 +0000 en <![CDATA[ NASA needs more astronauts for moon missions and beyond. You can apply now, but only until Dec. 3 ]]> If NASA ever hopes to build a permanent moon base for astronauts, let alone aim for Mars, the U.S. space agency is going to need a whole lot of space travelers. And now, you have a chance to be one of them.

NASA on Saturday (Nov. 7) put out the call for a new class of astronaut candidates who think they have the "right stuff" to fly, live and work in space. Those astronaut hopefuls have until Dec. 3 to apply (the application website is here), with NASA planning to make its final selections in late 2027.

"This is an extraordinary time to join NASA's astronaut corps," the space agency's chief, Jared Isaacman, said in an announcement, which was made during NASA's "Max Power" air show at Kennedy Space Center (KSC) in Florida. "The people we select could walk on the moon, live and work at the Moon Base, and help pioneer the systems and operations that will ultimately carry crews to Mars."

It's been two years since NASA last sought applications for astronauts. In 2024, more than 8,000 people applied, though only 10 — five men and five women — made the cut. They're in the middle of a two-year training program right now.

This new 2027 astronaut group will be the 25th astronaut class in NASA history. Its announcement comes the same year that NASA returned astronauts to the moon for the first time since the Apollo era with the Artemis II moon flyby. Four more astronauts will test Artemis moon landers in Earth orbit on the Artemis III mission in 2027.

NASA currently has 32 active astronauts in its spaceflying corps. The agency has recruited 370 people to fly in space since 1959, when the first seven Mercury astronauts were selected and unveiled to the world.

"There is a lot to be done in order to get all of these new vehicles and the new suits and everything as we continue to work towards the moon, build a base there, stay permanently, and then eventually onto Mars," NASA astronaut Nichole Stilwell, class of 2021, told Space.com in an interview at KSC during the Max Power event. "And so we just don't have enough people, and we're looking for more."

If you're interested in applying to be a NASA astronaut, you should take a look at the requirements first.

NASA's core guidelines require applicants to be U.S. citizens and have a master's degree in a STEM field like "engineering, biological science, physical science, or computer science from an accredited institution," the space agency said in a statement. You'll also need at least three years of experience in your related field.

Don't have a master's degree? Here's three other ways NASA might consider your application, according to the agency's advisory:

  • "Completion of at least two years of work toward a doctoral program in an appropriate technical field of engineering, biological science, physical science, computer science, or mathematics. 
  • "Completion of a Doctor of Medicine, Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine, Physician Assistant, Doctor of Nursing Practice, Family Nurse Practitioner, or a related medical degree. 
  • "Completion of, or current enrollment in, a nationally recognized Test Pilot School program, provided the program is completed by July 2027. If Test Pilot School is the only advanced technical degree, then completion of a bachelor’s degree in a STEM field, including engineering, biological science, physical science, or computer science is required."

If you're a medical doctor and are considering applying to be an astronaut, your residency training can be counted toward your professional experience, but only if it is completed by July 2027, NASA said.

If you want to be a pilot astronaut for NASA, you'll need some serious flight hours under your belt. Here's a rundown of some ways to meet that requirement:

  • 750 hours flying as pilot in command of high-performance jet aircraft.
  • 1,000 total flight hours in a rotary-wing aircraft, with 300 hours as pilot in command.
  • 1,500 total flight hours in other fixed-wing aircraft, with 750 hours as pilot in command.

"For those who apply, becoming a NASA astronaut is more than a career opportunity,” said NASA chief astronaut Scott Tingle, who also chairs the Astronaut Selection Board at the agency's Johnson Space Center (JSC) in Houston. "It is a chance to join a legacy of explorers who have pushed the boundaries of discovery and play a role in the missions that will shape humanity’s future in space."

Once NASA selects its 2027 astronaut class, the new recruits can expect to begin a two-year training program based out of JSC, which is home to the agency's astronaut corp and Mission Control.

“The window is open. The mission is waiting.," NASA Deputy Administrator Matt Anderson said in a statement. "And the only thing missing from the greatest adventure humanity has ever embarked upon is you."

Space.com Content Manager Chelsea Gohd contributed to this report from NASA's Max Power event at the Kennedy Space Center in Cape Canaveral, Florida.

A futuristic single-person aircraft takes to the skies at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida, with the upper stage of Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket providing a dramatic backdrop.

The unusual scene was captured during the MAX POWER event, which brought together innovators and emerging technologies at the iconic spaceflight facility.

What is it?

The photograph shows a single-person electric aircraft called Jetson ONE, developed by Jetson, a Swedish startup company working to bring personal flight to the skies.

The compact rotorcraft uses multiple propellers to climb into the air, allowing it to take off and vertically without the need for a runway.

The aircraft was performing flight demonstrations during the UP.Summit gathering, which formed part of the larger MAX POWER event at the Kennedy Space Center.

During the demonstrations, the Jetson ONE demonstrated its ability to maneuver through the air and hover in place, giving spectators a close-up look at the technology in action.

Why is it amazing?

The photograph offers a fascinating glimpse at two very different approaches to flight.

While Jetson is developing small electric aircraft designed for personal transportation, Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket is built to carry payloads far beyond Earth's atmosphere.

]]> <![CDATA[ SpaceX will launch epic double-catch Starship Flight 15 test mission on Nov. 13 ]]>

SpaceX will make spaceflight history this week, if all goes according to plan.

The company announced over the weekend that it's targeting Friday (Nov. 13) for the 15th test flight of its Starship megarocket, which will attempt something that's never been done before.

"The upcoming flight is planned to be the first to return both Starship and Super Heavy to the launch site for catch," SpaceX wrote in a description of Flight 15. "If successful, this will mark the first full recovery of an orbital launch system and a breakthrough moment in making Starship a reliable, rapidly reusable rocket."

Super Heavy is Starship's giant booster, and Starship (or Ship for short) is its upper-stage spacecraft. As SpaceX's description noted, both elements are designed to be fully and rapidly reusable.

"Catch" refers to SpaceX's recovery mechanism for both stages: Each will return to the launch mount at SpaceX's Starbase site in South Texas and be plucked out of the sky by the tower's "chopstick" arms.

SpaceX has caught Super Heavy on three Starship flights to date, but it has never tried the maneuver with Ship. It's a taller order; Ship flies higher and farther than Super Heavy, so its return to Earth is more complex and energetic.

SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk already told us that Flight 15 would likely feature a double-catch attempt. But the newly released mission description gives us a launch date, as well as details about the flight.

Starship Die Cast Rocket Model Was $47.99 Now $39.99 on Amazon.

Even if you can't see SpaceX's Starship in person, you can score a model of your own. Standing at 13.77 inches (35 cm), this is a 1:375 ratio of SpaceX's Starship as a desktop model. The materials here are alloy steel and it weighs just 225g.View Deal

Flight 15 is scheduled to launch from Starbase on Friday during a 75-minute window that opens at 5:45 p.m. EST (2245 GMT; 4:45 p.m. local Texas time).

Super Heavy will come back to Starbase for its tower catch about 6.5 minutes after liftoff, if all goes to plan. But Ship will stay up quite a bit longer.

The upper stage will go orbital, something Starship did for the first time on Flight 14 on Sept. 28. And, as on Flight 14, Ship will deploy 26 of SpaceX's next-gen Starlink V3 satellites, the vanguard of a new megaconstellation that will eventually consist of about 100,000 spacecraft, according to Musk.

But Ship should stay aloft for much longer on Flight 15 than it did on Flight 14, which ended with a splashdown in the northern Pacific Ocean about three hours after liftoff.

"Starship’s initial return to launch site mission is expected to orbit the Earth at an altitude of ~275 km [171 miles] and complete approximately 14 orbits around the planet over the course of a more than 22-hour flight," SpaceX wrote in its description of Flight 15.

"Similar to Starship’s first orbital mission, the flight profile has been designed with the opportunity to insert into a passively safe suborbital trajectory or safely deorbit at multiple pre-determined areas over the ocean after raising to an orbital altitude," the company added.

So there's no guarantee that Ship will indeed come back to Starbase for a catch on Flight 15; SpaceX will call off the try if anything is amiss. Whatever happens, however, you should definitely tune in. It's not every day, after all, that you can watch a rocket the size of a 40-story building take flight.

]]> <![CDATA[ Meteorite that landed in Cape Cod was a 'lone wolf' from the outer solar system, scientists find ]]> Thanks to a combination of radar, infrasound, dash-cam and security camera footage, astronomers have tracked the bright daytime meteor that fell over Cape Cod Bay in May 2026 back to its origin as a small asteroid perturbed by Jupiter and sent on a comet-like orbit towards Earth.

Meteor fireballs visible in the daytime are referred to as 'bolides'. At 1:06 p.m. local time (18:06 UTC) on May 30, 2026 one such bolide was widely witnessed falling out of the sky over coastal Massachusetts, with members of the public also reporting an associated sonic boom that rumbled across the north-eastern coast of the United States.

Now, a team of scientists from Europe and the United States, led by space physicist Juha Vierinen of the Arctic University of Norway in Tromsø, have patched together measurements from a meteor-observing radar network, regular weather radar, infrasound stations and camera footage to fully characterize the fall of this meteoroid and trace its orbit around the sun.

Key to these observations were measurements by the Spread Spectrum Interferometric Meteor Observing Network (SIMONe) based at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology's (MIT's) Haystack Observatory. SIMONe is a project jointly developed by MIT, the Arctic University of Norway and the Leibniz Institute of Atmospheric Physics in Kühlungsborn, Germany.

"We were fortunate that the event occurred within the coverage of SIMONe," Vierinen told Space.com.

This is echoed by Ryan Volz, a radio scientist at Haystack Observatory who is a member of the team who studied the May 30 bolide. "We got pretty lucky to observe this one," Volz told Space.com. ]]> <![CDATA[ NASA unveils $10 billion in moon base contracts, new lunar missions and the 'PROMISE' of a nuclear-powered rover ]]> CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. — NASA is pushing ahead with its plan to build a moon base for astronauts by 2032, with the agency unveiling up to $10 billion in contracts to launch and deliver cargo to the moon and other efforts on Saturday (Nov. 7).

The NASA announcement, revealed here during the space agency's "Max Power" air show event at Kennedy Space Center, included plans for a new $10 billion Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) framework, dubbed CLPS 2, about$1.3 billion in funding for the agency's Venture-Class Acquisition of Dedicated and Rideshare (VADR) program, and the nuclear-powered "PROMISE" rover on the moon.

The announcements mark another step in NASA's effort to establish infrastructure on the moon before Artemis astronauts return to its surface, including a rover and other cargo and research elements.

"Under the current CLPS contract, it's all all or nothing, which might be fine if you're only doing one or two of those [missions] per year," NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman told Space.com during a press conference on Saturday. "But when you're trying to scale up to what we're talking about today, you want to have the flexibility to move pieces around."

Landing cargo on the moon

NASA selected eight companies to compete for the new CLPS 2 missions under the framework: Blue Origin, Firefly Aerospace, Intuitive Machines, ispace-U.S., Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, SpaceX and Voyager Technologies.

The contracts for the 10-year CLPS 2 architecture carry a combined maximum value of $10 billion, rather than $10 billion in immediately awarded missions. NASA also increased the ceiling of its existing CLPS contract from $2.6 billion to $4.2 billion to support the agency's "Phase One" Moon Base objectives.

NASA is also following through on a promise Isaacman made in June, when he proposed repurposing an engineering model of the Perseverance and Curiosity Mars rovers (essentially an Earth-based twin) as a mission-ready rover to send to the moon. That rover, called PROMISE (short for "Polar Rover for Observation, Mapping, and In-Situ Exploration"), is a nuclear-powered robot intended to explore the lunar south pole beginning in late 2028.

The autonomous rover will carry a drill and scientific instruments to search for volatiles and water ice on the lunar surface. NASA awarded Blue Origin a $94 million base contract, with an additional $140 million option period based on performance, to deliver PROMISE to the lunar surface aboard its Blue Moon Mark 1 lander.

Communication satellites, navigation tests and more

In addition to that contract for Blue Origin, NASA awarded six launch and orbital transportation task orders worth a total of approximately $1.3 billion to Arrow Science and Technology, Blue Origin and Impulse Space under its Venture-Class Acquisition of Dedicated and Rideshare (VADR) program.

The missions will demonstrate commercial launch and orbital transportation capabilities, including cargo transfers between Earth and lunar orbits, navigation tests with the CAPSTONE 2 spacecraft and lunar scouting with "MoonFall" drones. Blue Origin, SpaceX and Relativity Space will provide launch support with their New Glenn, Falcon 9 and Terran R rockets, respectively.

Under a separate lunar logistics contract, NASA selected SpaceX to launch communications satellites aboard its Starship megarocket in 2028, helping to establish a future lunar communications network with spacecraft similar to the company's Starlink spacecraft.

NASA also awarded contracts to Honeybee Robotics, Redwire and Yank Technologies to develop components for a lunar power and communications tower, known as miniCAST.

The announcements support NASA's Phase One Moon Base strategy, which is scheduled to extend through 2029 and focuses on robotic exploration, infrastructure demonstrations and commercial deliveries. Phase Two, which runs from 2029 to 2032, will continue to build out infrastructure for the base, which will get up and running during Phase 3.

CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. — NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman knows how to make an entrance. Under the bright afternoon sun on Saturday (Nov. 7), Isaacman plummeted through the air above 10,000 onlookers, skydiving into the agency's air show MAX POWER.

MAX POWER overtook NASA's Kennedy Space Center here over the weekend, combining aeronautics and aerospace in a massive public air show, the first of its kind for the space agency. A mix of astronauts, fighter jet displays and new technology on display, the spectacle is a lot space-ier than a traditional air show, and Isaacman made sure to really showcase this merging of worlds. A pilot and private astronaut, Jared Isaacman is no stranger to the skies, and immediately after landing back on solid ground he jumped right back up and took to the event's main stage to greet an excited crowd.

"Going into this job, I I knew we had to do something like this," Isaacman said after landing and taking the stage. "We knew on our nation's 250th birthday, we had to open up [the] Kennedy Space Center the year that we returned our astronauts to the lunar environment and put on a little bit of a show."

EOS R5 Mark II: $3999

And put on a show he did.

From thousands of feet above a crowd holding their breath, Isaacman jumped out of a plane alongside members of Skydive Chicago and other notable individuals, including Montana senator Tim Sheehy (R-Montana) and former U.S. Air Force Thunderbird pilot Shawn Gustoson.

One by one, tiny white parachutes popped up in the sky above, which continued to grow in size as the skydivers neared the ground. And before we knew it, Isaacman was gracefully touching down just behind the air show's main stage, landing to the sound of cheers from the eager audience.

In addition to serving in his role as NASA Administrator, Isaacman is an entrepreneur, commercial astronaut and pilot. Known in flight by his callsign "Rook" which he was given during fighter jet training, Isaacman has so far logged over 8,000 flight hours. In 2009, he broke the world record for fastest trip around the world in a light jet (he made the trip in 61 hours, 51 minutes and 15 seconds) and is flight-qualified in a number of military jet aircraft. He also financed and flew on two private orbital space missions on a SpaceX Dragon, Inspiration4 and Polaris Dawn, performing the world's first private spacewalk on the latter misison.

Before jumping out of a plane and careening through the air on Saturday as part of this celebratory stunt, Isaacman was actually flying overhead in not one, but two different fighter jets.

First, he flew an F-5, a lightweight supersonic fighter jet, and just a short while later, Isaacman flew a MiG-29, a twin-engine supersonic fighter jet, over the crowd of excited air show attendees. And the fun didn't stop with this skydive, as Isaacman took to the skies once again, flying over the event in fighter jets on Sunday.

How do you follow this act?

This weekend's MAX POWER events are not a one-time-only celebration of aviation and aerospace at NASA. Earlier in the weekend, the agency announced that in 2028, a week-long event called CAPEWEEK will return to the Kennedy Space Center, promising a next-level showcase of air and space innovation and spectacle.

Isaacman and NASA astronauts presented President Donald Trump, who was onhand for the ceremony, with a gold plaque in his honor that will be installed at the Kennedy Space Center's Shuttle Landing Facility runway in time for the CAPEWEEK in 2028.

"What you are seeing today again, imagine March 2028," Isaacman said of the future. "It's going to be 10x bigger. I mean, not just the the fighter aircraft you're seeing, but displays of aerospace-related hardware, rovers, landers. We're going to bring commercial airliners in here ... I would bet on this, the next new Grand Airliner will be announced here."

"That kind of ambition is exactly that you should expect from your space agency," he added. "I promise you, there'll be more to come."

]]> <![CDATA[ Yes, it runs 'Doom': Satellite plays iconic game in world's 1st demonstration of orbital voice control ]]> A satellite went knee-deep in the dead, after a voice command from the ground activated the Doom video game in space.

Playing a first-person shooter from 1993 was obviously not in the design plan for the PRETTY cubesat, which is run by a consortium including the European Space Agency (ESA). But the pioneering voice command opens up new worlds for satellite work, the team says.

"Someone in distress at sea or in a remote area could transmit 'mayday' or "help" on a radio," stated Estonia's Tanagra Space, which supplied the software for the feat. The hope is one day, a satellite could use transcription and AI to alert rescue services for assisting folks in remote zones.

The call to play Doom, thankfully, had no other urgency than curiosity — and teamwork, fueled by pizza. OPS-SAT Space Lab managed the experiment on behalf of ESA. Radio amateurs then made six unsuccessful attempts during passes over Poland and Norway, between April and July. The seventh finally reached success under the Oslo Group of the Norwegian Radio Relay League.

"We are radio amateurs, with the emphasis on amateurs. Satellite work was not something our club did, and we had no budget for it," representative Eskil Hadland, call sign LB6AJ, said in the Tangara statement. "So we borrowed a line wrongly credited to Pippi Longstocking: 'I have never tried that before, so I should definitely be able to do that.'"

The Norwegians spent 59 days and about 7200 NOK or $775 (pizza included) to reach PRETTY, helping make changes to the satellite software to pick up a voice. For example, a raw recording of an attempt on July 3, retransmitted to Earth, showed the spoken words to space were unrecognizable. Further work revealed the satellite's receiver channel was too wide to pick up the voice signal, leading to a fix to narrow the channel.

The historic voice command on July 27— in part, "PRETTY play Doom Doom Doom"— came from a rooftop in Oslo, and was spoken at night by Jon Bergli Heier (LB9BJ). PRETTY picked up the transmission, transcribed the command using on-board voice recognition, and then — just like a typical evening gamer—opened up Doom for a play session.

This was no multiplayer gaming situation, but the satellite did create a report of its demon-slaying skills — and its ability to interpret the command. For example, PRETTY generated a "postcard" including a frame of the gameplay, a transcription, and signal diagnostics. The satellite also transmitted its recording of Hadland's command.

As anybody who uses voice-recognition software knows, there are challenges in transcriptions: nobody speaks in exactly the same way, and aspects such as accent or background noise can lead to misinterpretations. The satellite also had to contend with Doppler shift, and with an antenna not designed to relay voices to space.

But the transmission clearly worked, powered by open-source tools including GNU Radio (which handled the signal processing) and Sherpa-ONNX (speech recognition).

The hope is that future spacecraft could one day adapt this approach to radio frequencies for other ideas outside of spoken words. A satellite went knee-deep in the dead, after a voice command from the ground activated the Doom video game in space.

Playing a first-person shooter from 1993 was obviously not in the design plan for the PRETTY cubesat, which is run by a consortium including the European Space Agency (ESA). But the pioneering voice command opens up new worlds for satellite work, the team says.

"Someone in distress at sea or in a remote area could transmit 'mayday' or "help" on a radio," stated Estonia's Tanagra Space, which supplied the software for the feat. The hope is one day, a satellite could use transcription and AI to alert rescue services for assisting folks in remote zones.

The call to play Doom, thankfully, had no other urgency than curiosity — and teamwork, fueled by pizza. OPS-SAT Space Lab managed the experiment on behalf of ESA. Radio amateurs then made six unsuccessful attempts during passes over Poland and Norway, between April and July. The seventh finally reached success under the Oslo Group of the Norwegian Radio Relay League.

"We are radio amateurs, with the emphasis on amateurs. Satellite work was not something our club did, and we had no budget for it," representative Eskil Hadland, call sign LB6AJ, said in the Tangara statement. "So we borrowed a line wrongly credited to Pippi Longstocking: 'I have never tried that before, so I should definitely be able to do that.'"

The Norwegians spent 59 days and about 7200 NOK or $775 (pizza included) to reach PRETTY, helping make changes to the satellite software to pick up a voice. For example, a raw recording of an attempt on July 3, retransmitted to Earth, showed the spoken words to space were unrecognizable. Further work revealed the satellite's receiver channel was too wide to pick up the voice signal, leading to a fix to narrow the channel.

The historic voice command on July 27— in part, "PRETTY play Doom Doom Doom"— came from a rooftop in Oslo, and was spoken at night by Jon Bergli Heier (LB9BJ). PRETTY picked up the transmission, transcribed the command using on-board voice recognition, and then — just like a typical evening gamer—opened up Doom for a play session.

This was no multiplayer gaming situation, but the satellite did create a report of its demon-slaying skills — and its ability to interpret the command. For example, PRETTY generated a "postcard" including a frame of the gameplay, a transcription, and signal diagnostics. The satellite also transmitted its recording of Hadland's command.

As anybody who uses voice-recognition software knows, there are challenges in transcriptions: nobody speaks in exactly the same way, and aspects such as accent or background noise can lead to misinterpretations. The satellite also had to contend with Doppler shift, and with an antenna not designed to relay voices to space.

But the transmission clearly worked, powered by open-source tools including GNU Radio (which handled the signal processing) and Sherpa-ONNX (speech recognition).

The hope is that future spacecraft could one day adapt this approach to radio frequencies for other ideas outside of spoken words. For example, perhaps deep-space radio signals could be detected via satellite, with an AI on board sending the most relevant data to operators after analyzing the work.

The legendary sci-fi mag went dark back in 2009 as part of the wave of popular publications folding due to years of declining readership and subscriptions. But as of Nov. 13, this geek favorite periodical returns as an annual print edition, and it's available for pre-order now.

It’s another indication of digital fatigue in the world, and fans of a certain age will recall the pleasure of poring over each colorful issue packed with in-depth interviews, behind-the-scenes photos, TV guides, classic movie retrospectives, book reviews, con news, and VFX features.

"Starlog" launched in 1976, in the pre-"Star Wars" days, under the leadership of editor-in-chief Kerry O’Quinn. It first arrived with artist Jack Thurston's beautiful painted "Star Trek" cover, featuring William Shatner as Captain James T. Kirk and Leonard Nimoy’s Spock, set against the U.S.S. Enterprise near a shimmering black hole.

The magazine continued to inform the science fiction community about upcoming sci-fi TV shows and blockbuster Hollywood films for over three decades; I fondly recall reading each informative and entertaining monthly issue cover-to-cover.

Just in time to honor its 50th anniversary this year, "Starlog" blasts back into the sci-fi universe with Issue #375 showcasing cover artwork created by Armenian artist Gabriel Yeganyan. Its geek culture legacy, covering iconic franchises like "Star Wars," "Star Trek," and "Alien," will now live on thanks to Fangoria Holdings and io9 co-founder Annalee Newitz, editor-in-chief.

"During its original 33-year run, 'Starlog' documented science fiction as it evolved across film, television, books, technology, and culture," said 'Fangoria's Tara Ansley.

"Fifty years after the magazine first launched, the line between science fiction and the real world has become increasingly difficult to separate. That makes this an especially interesting time to bring 'Starlog' back. Technology may change, but the most compelling questions have always been about people: how we live, what we create, and what kind of future we want to build."

"Starlog" reloads for its first annual edition after a long hiatus on Nov. 13. You can pre-order the first issue (Issue 375 in continuity) on the Starlog website.

]]> <![CDATA[ On this day in space! Nov. 8, 2005: Europe launches Venus Express, its first mission to Venus ]]>

On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. The spacecraft was called Venus Express.

Venus is a hothouse planet, one where the atmospheric pressure can easily crush an unprotected spacecraft. Even from orbit, Venus Express had to survive harsh radiation. But the spacecraft lasted for more than nine years.

During that time, Venus Express saw a weird vortex swirling around Venus's south pole. It also saw possible signs of active volcanoes. Venus Express also discovered that the planet generates its own auroras. These auroras happen when particles from the sun hit charged particles in the atmosphere.

Late in the Venus Express mission, controllers told the spacecraft to dip down into Venus's clouds — even though the spacecraft wasn't designed to do this. It performed well, but eventually it stopped listening to commands. The spacecraft burned up in the atmosphere in January 2015.

Why it mattered

Venus Express established ESA as the third world organization to successfully send a probe to study Venus, following the United States and Soviet Union. (Japan's JAXA became the fourth five years later.)

"By studying Venus, scientists learn how Earth-like planets change over time," reads a summary of the planet's exploration prepared by The Planetary Society. "Orbital studies [like Venus Express] hint that Venus may have hosted habitable oceans before becoming inhospitable."

"By studying Venus, we can learn how Earth-like planets evolve and what shapes planets throughout the galaxy into temperate, lush worlds instead of sweltering hothouses. Venus also helps scientists model Earth’s climate, and may serve as a cautionary tale on how dramatically a planet’s climate can change," wrote the Society.

ESA returned to Venus in 2018 when BepiColombo, its joint mission with JAXA, used the planet's gravity to redirect its path toward the planet Mercury.

]]> <![CDATA[ Who is King Ghidorah? The cosmic connections of Godzilla Minus Zero's foe ]]> Godzilla goes toe-to-toe with long-time foe King Ghidorah in Godzilla Minus Zero, which opened in theaters on Friday (Nov. 6). Though the three-headed golden Kaiju might seem like a natural native of Monster Island, King Ghidorah actually emerged from the depths of space.

However, it isn't just the origins of King Ghidorah — also known as Monster Zero in the Godzilla movie Invasion of Astro-Monster (1965) — that are this beast's only cosmic connection. One of the largest structures in the universe, the King Ghidorah Supercluster, was named in honor of Godzilla's primary antagonist.

Eat that, King Kong!

King Ghidorah and Godzilla

King Ghidorah is a three-headed, twin-tailed golden dragon from the stars, first introduced in the fifth Godzilla movie, Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster (1964).

In this first appearance, part of the Shōwa era (1964–1975) of Godzilla history, Ghidorah ravaged Venus, wiping out its population 5,000 years before arriving on Earth encased within a highly magnetic meteorite. Ghidorah was bested this first time by Godzilla, Rodan, and Mothra.

Undeterred, Ghidorah returned for a rematch just a year later in Invasion of Astro Monster (1965), after being discovered supposedly terrorizing the inhabitants of Planet X, a world found beyond Jupiter. In this movie, it is revealed that Ghidorah is less a king and more a pawn, under the control of calculating Xiliens as part of a plan to subjugate Earth. This will become a theme.

Freed from that control, Ghidorah returns to deep space, once again falling under the thrall of an alien race in 1968's Destroy All Monsters.

This movie sees Ghidorah hold its own against a who's who of kaiju, eventually succumbing to the combined might of Godzilla, Minilla, Mothra, Rodan, Manda, Gorosaurus, Anguirus, Kumonga, Baragon, and Varan.

Even with three gravity-beam-blasting heads, that is hardly fair!

Ghidorah returned with some backup for a final time in the Shōwa era in 1975's Godzilla vs. Gigan. This time, Ghidorah and his tag-team partner Gigan (who resembled a giant one-eyed space chicken) were under the control of cockroach-like Nebulans. Getting mind-controlled three times is just embarrassing!

Fortunately, the Shōwa era drew to a close in 1975 before Ghidorah was forced into servitude for a fourth time.

Ghidorah returned in the rebooted Godzilla timeline of the Heisei era (1991–1998) in 1991's Godzilla Vs. King Ghidorah, but its cosmic origins are gone. The Heisei Ghidorah begins life as three genetically engineered creatures called Dorats in the future before being morphed into a three-headed form via nuclear exposure.

Ghidorah was given a spiritual origin in the Millennium era's Godzilla, Mothra, and King Ghidorah: Giant Monsters All-Out Attack (2001), actually serving as a protagonist, helping Mothra in halting Godzilla's rampage.

Ghidorah is once again an extraterrestrial in Universal Pictures' MonsterVerse movie Godzilla: King of the Monsters (2019), being described as having "fallen from the stars" in ancient times before rising to challenge Godzilla.

Now King Ghidorah is back once again in Godzilla Minus Zero, maintaining his extraterrestrial origin story and once again challenging Godzilla to an epic kaiju battle.

Those are some of the fictional versions of this golden beast, but what does it look like in reality?

The real King Ghidorah!

Arguably the most impressive feat of King Ghidorah has been to make itself such an important part of pop culture that astronomers took note.

The King Ghidorah supercluster is a collection of galaxies located around 6.7 billion light-years from Earth. Covering an area of the sky equivalent to 19 full moons, as seen from our vantage point, this cosmic Kaiju was discovered in late 2022 by Japanese astronomers using data from the Subaru Telescope.

The King Ghidorah supercluster is comprised of at least 19 individual associated galaxy clusters. It stretches out for an incredible 1.3 billion light-years, meaning the entire Milky Way could fit across it around 12,300 times. That makes it the largest supercluster ever discovered.

To put into context just how monstrous the King Ghidorah supercluster is, consider the fact that it has a mass equivalent to 10,000,000,000,000,000 suns, 10 times as massive as the Milky Way's home supercluster, Laniakea.

Even Godzilla may think twice before attempting to tussle with that particular King Ghidorah!

See King Ghidorah in action in Godzilla Minus Zero, which is showing in theaters in the US and UK from November 6. You can see the preceding movie, Godzilla Minus One, on Netflix.

 <description>Soud zamítl návrh na neplatnost hlasování v komunálních volbách v Liberci. Návrh končícího náměstka primátora Adama Lenerta (ANO) byl založen jen na statistických odchylkách a soud ho odmítl jako nedůvodný, vyplývá z rozhodnutí na úřední desce pobočky krajského soudu v Liberci. Šlo o jedinou stížnost na výsledky voleb v pátém největším městě v ČR, nic tak nebrání svolání ustavujícího zastupitelstva. </description>

  <item>
   <title>Mají se Češi bát salmonely? Kontroly jsou teď důkladnější, situace bývala horší</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/zdravotnictvi/cesko-zdravi-salmonela-maso-vajicka-priznaky-dieta/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=zdravotnictvi</link>
   <description>V posledních týdnech se v Česku často skloňuje salmonela. Odborníci ze Státní zemědělské a potravinářské inspekce a Státní veterinární správy totiž tuto bakterii opakovaně našli v kuřecím mase, které nabízely některé supermarkety. Ty ho následně ze svých prodejen stáhly. Hojně medializován byl i případ základní školy v Praze 21-Újezdu nad Lesy, kde se ze stravy nakazily stovky dětí salmonelózou. Deník.cz přináší srovnání současné situace s minulými lety, informace o nemoci i tipy na jídla po prodělané nákaze.</description>
   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:30:00 +0100</pubDate>

   </media:content>
  </item>
  <item>
   <title>Nezaměstnanost v Libereckém kraji rostla. Přibylo ale i pracovních příležitostí</title>
   <link>https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/zpravy-region/nezamestnanost-v-libereckem-kraji-rostla-pribylo-ale-i-pracovnich-prilezitosti/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=zpravy-region</link>
   <description>Podzimní ochlazení na pracovním trhu se začíná projevovat také v Libereckém kraji. V říjnu zde počet lidí bez práce opět vzrostl, a to napříč všemi okresy. Úřad práce evidoval celkem 17 555 uchazečů o zaměstnání, což je o 200 více než v září a o 1 227 více než před rokem. Podíl nezaměstnaných tak dosáhl 5,7 procenta.</description>
   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:45:37 +0100</pubDate>
   <guid>https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/zpravy-region/nezamestnanost-v-libereckem-kraji-rostla-pribylo-ale-i-pracovnich-prilezitosti/</guid>
   <category>Českolipsko </category>
   <enclosure url="https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/images/api/image/1366x768/a3c/a3ca8da6-4685-4315-a062-61fa69e2bf45.jpeg" length="0" type="image/jpeg"/>
   <media:content url="https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/images/api/image/1366x768/a3c/a3ca8da6-4685-4315-a062-61fa69e2bf45.jpeg" medium="image" height="768" width="1366">
    <media:description>Když přijdete o zaměstnání a splníte požadované podmínky, stát vám vyplatí podporu v nezaměstnanosti. Jak dlouho ji budete dostávat a v jaké výši se odvíjí od vašeho věku.</media:description>
    <media:credit>Wikimedia Commons/Czeva/ CC BY-SA 3.0</media:credit>
   </media:content>
  </item>
  <item>
   <title>Zemřela mi tam přítelkyně, svěřil se muž z Doks po požáru budovy u zámku</title>
   <link>https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/zpravy-region/pozar-doksy-zamek-bezdomovec-obeti/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=zpravy-region</link>
   <description>Zanedbaná budova v areálu zámku v Doksech se o víkendu stala dějištěm tragédie. V sobotu večer tam zasahující u požáru našli dvě těla bez známek života. Reportérka Deníku se na místě v pondělí kolem poledne potkala s mužem, který měl slzy v očích. V troskách podle jeho slov zemřela žena, kterou označuje za svou přítelkyni. Přišel zkontrolovat, že hoří svíčky, které tu pro ni ráno pietně zapálil.</description>
   <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:03:49 +0100</pubDate>
   <guid>https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/zpravy-region/pozar-doksy-zamek-bezdomovec-obeti/</guid>

    <media:description>Tragická událost na začátku listopadu v Doksech si vyžádala dvě lidské oběti.</media:description>

   </media:content>

  <item>
   <title>Tušili jsme, že někoho zabije, řekla spolužačka. Střelec z Polska měl sešit katů</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/evropa/polsko-krakov-strelec-si-maloval-do-sesitu-katy-spoluzaci-ze-skoly-byli-vydeseni/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=evropa</link>
   <description>Bývalá spolužačka popsala čtyřiadvacetiletého Michała O., který v sobotu v polském Krakově zastřelil šest lidí a dalších nejméně šestnáct zranil. Vzpomínala na znepokojivé kresby katů a ozbrojenců v jeho sešitech i na podivné chování. Spolu s dalšími žáky už během školních let vtipkoval, že jednou někoho zabije.</description>

   <description>Proč se lidé pod vlivem drog dopouštějí závažného násilí? Jak drogy vypínají části mozku?     <item>
      <title>Největší účast v jeho životě. Na papežovu mši v Buenos Aires šly miliony lidí</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/zahranicni/mse-papez-lev-buenos-aires-miliony-lide-argentina-cesta-davy.A261109_170240_zahranicni_fohl#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Pondělní mše s papežem Lvem XIV. v argentinské metropoli Buenos Aires se zúčastnilo 2,5 milionu lidí, uvedl Vatikán. Místní úřady dříve odhadly počet přítomných na dva miliony lidí, píší média. Papež je druhým dnem v Argentině, kde dříve navštívil také středisko péče o postižené, jehož fungování ohrožují vládní škrty.</description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:49:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <category domain="https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/zahranicni">Zprávy - Zahraničí</category>
      <comments>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/zahranicni/mse-papez-lev-buenos-aires-miliony-lide-argentina-cesta-davy.A261109_170240_zahranicni_fohl/diskuse</comments>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">A261109_170240_zahranicni_fohl</guid>
      <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/26/111/cl6/FOH925e336a33_442543e88d378813dd9d1a4b.jpg" type="image/jpeg" />
      <media:description>Papež Lev XIV. na mši ve čtvrti Palermo v argentinské metropoli Buenos Aires přijel ve speciálním vozu papamobilu a zdravil lidi podél cesty. (9. listopadu 2026)</media:description>
      <media:credit>AP</media:credit>
      <media:group>
        <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/26/111/cl6/FOH925e336a33_442543e88d378813dd9d1a4b.jpg" type="image/jpeg" />
        <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/26/111/cl6/FOH8fcdb25aca_233_POPE_LATAM_ARGENTINA.JPG" type="image/jpeg" />
      </media:group>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Kauza vydání knihy zpochybňující holokaust. Soud znovu rozhodl, uložil podmínky</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/brno/zpravy/kniha-holokaust-brno-mestsky-soud-podminky-zprosteni-viny.A261109_151549_brno-zpravy_zubr#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>V případu vydání knihy Germara Rudolfa Holocaust pod lupou, která zpochybňuje fakta o holokaustu, v pondělí Městský soud v Brně uložil třem obžalovaným podmíněné tresty, potrestal i nakladatelství. Tresty dostali jako organizovaná skupina, a to za založení, podporu a propagaci hnutí směřujícího k potlačení práv a svobod člověka, a za popírání genocidy.</description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:48:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <category domain="https://www.idnes.cz/brno/zpravy">Brno - Zprávy</category>
      <comments>https://www.idnes.cz/brno/zpravy/kniha-holokaust-brno-mestsky-soud-podminky-zprosteni-viny.A261109_151549_brno-zpravy_zubr/diskuse</comments>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">A261109_151549_brno-zpravy_zubr</guid>
      <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/25/013/cl6/AZU6831f2464c_P2025012302337.jpg" type="image/jpeg" />
      <media:description>Městský soud v Brně se začal ve čtvrtek 23. ledna 2025 zabývat projednáváním druhé části případu vydávání některých publikací, mimo jiné knihy zpochybňující holokaust. Z popírání genocidy žalobce viní Vítězslava Baránka (vpravo), Pavla Kamase (třetí zleva), Erika Sedláčka (vlevo) a Lukáše Nováka (druhý zleva).</media:description>
      <media:credit>ČTK</media:credit>
      <media:group>
        <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/25/074/cl6/AZU522d5c4393_P2025073102591.jpeg" type="image/jpeg" />
        <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/25/013/cl6/AZU67a1c655dd_P2025012302328.jpg" type="image/jpeg" />
      </media:group>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Vláda schválila zákon o celostátním referendu i regulaci cen elektřiny v krizi</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/jednani-vlady-referendum-ceny-energii.A261109_092927_domaci_mul#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Vláda na svém dnešním dosud nejdelším zasedání projednávala velké množství návrhů. Schválila například možnost zavedení celostátního referenda, ke kterému ale potřebuje ústavní většinu. Řešila také zastropování cen energií, což ministr průmyslu a obchodu Karel Havlíček (ANO) naznačil už v neděli. Cenová úroveň, při jaké by vláda přistoupila k zastropování, ale teprve bude předmětem debat.</description>

    <item>
      <title>Vládní návrh o referendu je zatím bez šance. Nepodpoříme ho, zní z opozice</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/zakon-o-celostatnim-referendu-narazi-u-opozice.A261109_163224_domaci_sahu#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Zákon o referendu, na který v pondělí kývla vláda, bude zcela jistě čelit odporu ve Sněmovně. Vyplývá to z vyjádření zástupců opozice pro iDNES.cz. Zatímco strany vládní koalice by zavedení tohoto nástroje uvítaly, zástupci ODS, KDU-ČSL, TOP 09 i Pirátů jej v současné podobě odmítají. Jedná se ale o ústavní zákon, k jehož přijetí vláda potřebuje 120 hlasů, tedy i ty z opačného tábora.</description>

      <description>Ředitel Správy Krkonošského národního parku (KRNAP) Petr Moravec čelil dalšímu problému.       <description>Nejvyšší státní zástupkyně Lenka Bradáčová podala dovolání v trestní kauze plakátů vládního hnutí SPD. Rozdílnými právními názory v této věci by se měl podle ní zabývat Nejvyšší soud a vyjádřit se tak k limitům politického projevu v předvolební kampani. Sdělil to mluvčí Nejvyššího státního zastupitelství Petr Malý. Podle hnutí SPD plakáty vyjadřují většinový názor společnosti, tedy například odpor proti migračnímu paktu.</description>

<title>Konec zaostávání? EU rozdá miliardy na návrh vlastních čipů, projekt pomohli vytvořit Češi</title>
<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/konec-zaostavani-eu-rozda-miliardy-na-navrh-vlastnich-cipu-projekt-pomohli-vytvorit-cesi/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Takzvaný evropský zákon o čipech (Chips Act) sice nezvládl cíl zvý&#353;it klesající podíl Evropy ve výrobě čipů, ale několik továren přece jen vzniklo či vzniká. Rozjely se i dal&#353;í aktivity, které Chips Act obsahuje. Teď odstatovala i European Chips Design Platform (EuroCDP) zpřístupňující software pro návrh čipů z jednoho místa.</description>

 <description>Ruská delegace odletěla do Abú Zabí na jednání se zástupci Ukrajiny a Spojených států, oznámila v pondělí ruská státní agentura TASS. Rozhovory o ukončení války Ruska proti Ukrajině, která pokračuje pátý rok, se budou konat v úterý a ve středu.  <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/co-delat-kdyz-se-na-verejnosti-strili-nesnazit-si-vec-natacet-nebo-eliminovat_2611091628_raf</link>
 <description>Polsko již druhým dnem drží státní smutek za oběti střelby v centru Krakova. Útočník v sobotu zavraždil šest lidí a dalších 15 zranil. Střelec v pondělí ráno zemřel v nemocnici. Jak se mají lidé chovat v případě střelby na veřejném prostranství? „Vylézt někam na vršek a podívat se, odkud střelba pochází, asi není úplně dobrý nápad,“ říká pro Radiožurnál bezpečnostní expert Stanislav Kazbunda ze soukromé školy Trivis.</description>

</item>

 <description>Velká Británie si připomněla válečné veterány. Po celé zemi se odehrála řada vzpomínkových pochodů a shromáždění, která připomínají padlé vojáky a válečné veterány. Hlavní pieta se odehrála za účasti královské rodiny v centru Londýna a po desáté se jí zúčastnili i čeští veteráni.</description>

 <description>Maďarské úřady zadržely Árona Orbána, bratra někdejšího dlouholetého premiéra Viktora Orbána, a to kvůli podezření z pašování lidí. V pondělí o tom informovala maďarská média. Expremiér Orbán, který je lídrem nyní opoziční strany Fidesz, prohlásil, že skutečným cílem této operace je on sám, napsala agentura MTI.</description>

 <description>Za necelé dva měsíce začne fungovat nový obranný projekt Evropské unie AGILE. Malým a středním podnikům má umožnit hlásit se o milionové granty s projekty, které mohou najít využití u evropských armád. „Představa je taková, že finální nasazení by mělo nastat do roku, maximálně tří let. To je v porovnání s klasickým zaváděním obranných technologií neskutečně rychlé,“ uvedl v pořadu Bruselské chlebíčky analytik Filip Nerad.</description>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/byl-jsem-neverny-sve-manzelce-sef-nvidie-navazal-vztah-s-cinskou-spionkou-firma_2611090856_raf</link>
 <description>Americký výrobce čipů Nvidia vyšetřuje zprávy o tom, že jeho šéf Jensen Huang navázal vztah se ženou, která je podezřelá ze špionáže pro Čínu. Oznámila to firma. Nvidia patří mezi nejhodnotnější podniky na světě a dominuje globálnímu trhu s čipy pro umělou inteligenci (AI). Třiašedesátiletý Huang podle agentury Bloomberg vztah s touto ženou přiznal.</description>

</item>
<item>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/zemrel-utocnik-z-krakova-v-centru-mesta-zabil-sest-lidi_2611090715_raf</link>
 <description>Útočník, který v sobotu v centru Krakova zabil šest lidí a dalších 15 zranil, v pondělí ráno v nemocnici zemřel, informuje na síti X polská policie. Podle stanice TVN 24 informaci potvrdil Krzysztof Klenczar, jenž stojí v čele Malopolského vojvodství se správním centrem Krakovem. Policisté útočníka po činu postřelili. Muž podle prokuratury zřejmě také zastřelil další tři lidi: své rodiče a sestru. Jejich těla byla nalezena v jeho bytě.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-11-08t111304z_1_261108-134316_vsn.JPG?itok=rOeAg0y6" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 07:15:00 +0100</pubDate>
</item>
<item>

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/epsteinuv-ostrov-irozhlas-cesky-rozhlas-plus_2611090700_nel</link>
 <description>Jak se z opakovaného zneužívání stal systém, který desítky let nikdo nezastavil? Proč oběti často nedokázaly odejít nebo promluvit? A jakou roli hráli lidé a instituce, kteří možná neznali celý rozsah Epsteinových zločinů, ale pomáhali udržovat jeho svět v chodu? Odpovědi hledá nová šestidílná dokumentární série Českého rozhlasu Plus Epsteinův ostrov, která startuje 9. listopadu.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/epsteinuv-ostrov_210_261105-170211_nel.jpg?itok=T6rdd-vZ" type="image/jpeg" />

</item>
<item>
 <title>Dronový útok způsobil požár rafinerie v Leningradské oblasti. U Petrohradu zemřela žena</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/online-drony-zautocily-na-prumyslovou-oblast-na-severozapade-ruska-poskodily_2611090606_raf</link>
 <description>Drony zasáhly průmyslovou oblast v Kiriši v Leningradské oblasti na severozápadě Ruska, kde způsobily požár rafinerie. V pondělí o tom na Telegramu informoval tamní gubernátor Alexandr Drozděnko. Uvedl také, že ve městě Vsevoložsk u Petrohradu po dopadu trosek dronu na bytový dům zahynula žena. Drozděnko informoval o sestřelení 113 ukrajinských dronů. Ukrajina podniká údery v hloubi Ruska v sebeobraně, země od února 2022 vzdoruje ruské invazi.</description>

Dopravní podnik pozval preventisty z celého Česka</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905075-pohyb-s-detmi-v-mestskem-provozu-dopravni-podnik-pozval-preventisty-z-celeho-ceska.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905075-pohyb-s-detmi-v-mestskem-provozu-dopravni-podnik-pozval-preventisty-z-celeho-ceska.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:45:00 +0100</pubDate><category>Doprava</category><description>Na šest desítek policejních preventistů přišlo do libereckého dopravního podniku. Důvod? Aby si na vlastní kůži vyzkoušeli a osahali, jak se pohybovat v blízkosti zastávek MHD, autobusů a tramvají. Své zkušenosti pak předají ve školách a školkách.</description></item><item><title>Speciální tričko pro řidiče z Liberce má vylepšenou verzi</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905275-specialni-tricko-pro-ridice-z-liberce-ma-vylepsenou-verzi.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905275-specialni-tricko-pro-ridice-z-liberce-ma-vylepsenou-verzi.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Vědci z liberecké univerzity loni představili tričko se senzory, které dokáže podle dechu řidičky nebo řidiče rozpoznat nastupující nebezpečnou únavu dříve, než hrozí mikrospánek. Vývoj ale pokračoval a nyní proběhlo testování druhé verze trika.</description></item><item><title>Stovky cejnů i osmikiloví kapři šli z vody. Zoo Liberec zachraňuje Labutí jezírko</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905302-stovky-cejnu-i-osmikilovi-kapri-sli-z-vody-zoo-liberec-zachranuje-labuti-jezirko.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905302-stovky-cejnu-i-osmikilovi-kapri-sli-z-vody-zoo-liberec-zachranuje-labuti-jezirko.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:00:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Stovky cejnů, osmikilové kapry i škeble museli rybáři odchytit z vypuštěného Labutího jezírka v Zoo Liberec. Historické vodní ploše z roku 1900 hrozila havárie hráze, a tak ji čeká rozsáhlá rekonstrukce za 20 milionů korun. Vznikne tu i nový ostrov, který se stane domovem pro další skupinu lemurů.</description></item><item><title>Ranní karambol na tahu I/13: Auto skončilo mimo silnici, příčinu vyšetřují policisté</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905294-ranni-karambol-na-tahu-i-13-auto-skoncilo-mimo-silnici-pricinu-vysetruji-policiste.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/905294-ranni-karambol-na-tahu-i-13-auto-skoncilo-mimo-silnici-pricinu-vysetruji-policiste.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:56:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>Mezi Rynolticemi a Bílým Kostelem nad Nisou skončilo ráno auto mimo vozovku, až za ochranným plotem proti zvěři. Zraněnou řidičku odvezla záchranka do nemocnice. Na místě zasahovaly složky IZS, policie řídí dopravu a apeluje na opatrnost řidičů, provoz v úseku je sveden do jednoho pruhu.</description></item><item><title>Po oblačném týdnu s deštěm se slunce vrátí až o víkendu</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905270-po-oblacnem-tydnu-s-destem-se-slunce-vrati-az-o-vikendu.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905270-po-oblacnem-tydnu-s-destem-se-slunce-vrati-az-o-vikendu.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:52:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Do víkendu bude v Česku převážně oblačno nebo zataženo s deštěm a teplotami do deseti stupňů Celsia, do středy může v noci mrznout. Sněžit včetně středečního svátku svatého Martina může jen na horách, Na víkend se vrátí slunce a mrazivá rána.</description></item><item><title>V Liberci bude k Týdnu svobody sedm akcí, zapojí se divadla, muzeum i galerie</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905240-v-liberci-bude-k-tydnu-svobody-sedm-akci-zapoji-se-divadla-muzeum-i.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905240-v-liberci-bude-k-tydnu-svobody-sedm-akci-zapoji-se-divadla-muzeum-i.html</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 06:54:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>V Liberci se budou k Týdnu svobody konat divadelní představení, debaty i projekce. Do celostátní akce se od 11. do 17. listopadu zapojí obě městská divadla i krajské Severočeské muzeum a galerie Lázně. Za organizátory z iniciativy "Díky, že můžem" o tom informovala Julie Podlaha Zákostelecká.</description></item><item><title>Nové meteostanice i kamery. Jablonec modernizuje varovný a informační systém</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905084-nove-meteostanice-i-kamery-jablonec-modernizuje-varovny-a-informacni-system.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905084-nove-meteostanice-i-kamery-jablonec-modernizuje-varovny-a-informacni-system.html</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 19:58:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Do konce příštího roku by měl mít Jablonec zmodernizovaný varovný a informační systém. Celkové náklady jsou necelých 19 milionů korun a město pak bude moci rychleji reagovat na krizové situace.</description></item><item><title>Jablonečtí fotbalisté v lize remizovali doma 0:0 s Mladou Boleslaví</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/fotbal/905247-jablonecti-fotbaliste-v-lize-remizovali-doma-0-0-s-mladou-boleslavi.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/fotbal/905247-jablonecti-fotbaliste-v-lize-remizovali-doma-0-0-s-mladou-boleslavi.html</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 17:21:27 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Fotbal</category><description>Fotbalisté Jablonce ve 14. kole první ligy remizovali doma 0:0 s Mladou Boleslaví. Severočeši jsou po posledním zápase před reprezentační pauzou sedmí, Středočechům patří v neúplné tabulce třetí příčka.</description></item><item><title>Hřebeny Krkonoš hlásí třetí návštěvnicky nejsilnější léto od začátku měření</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905081-hrebeny-krkonos-hlasi-treti-navstevnicky-nejsilnejsi-leto-od-zacatku-mereni.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/905081-hrebeny-krkonos-hlasi-treti-navstevnicky-nejsilnejsi-leto-od-zacatku-mereni.html</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 14:32:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Návštěvnost krkonošských hřebenů letos od července do září dosáhla přibližně 518.000 průchodů na sledovaných měřicích bodech. Ve srovnání s loňskem jde o šestiprocentní nárůst a oproti roku 2024 dokonce o 19 procent víc.</description></item><item><title>Svrab se vrací ve velkém. Nakažených jsou tisíce, pozor i na hotelové sedačky</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/zdravi/904984-svrab-se-vraci-ve-velkem-nakazenych-jsou-tisice-pozor-i-na-hotelove-sedacky.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/zdravi/904984-svrab-se-vraci-ve-velkem-nakazenych-jsou-tisice-pozor-i-na-hotelove-sedacky.html</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 12:45:00 +0100</pubDate><dc:creator>Hanka Poskočilová</dc:creator><category>Zdraví</category><description>Svrab rozhodně není problém, který by se týkal jen zanedbané hygieny nebo lidí žijících v nevyhovujících podmínkách. V Česku se letos nakazilo už přes 11 400 lidí, pět z nich zemřelo a odborníci varují, že nepříjemného parazita si můžete přivézt třeba i z luxusního hotelu.</description></item></channel></rss>

    <item>
      <title>Aktualizovaný přehled slev na Black Friday 2026. Kde a co se vyplatí nakoupit?</title>
      <link>https://www.zive.cz/clanky/black-friday-2026/sc-3-a-244154/default.aspx</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244154-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Až do konce listopadu zde najdete nejzajímavější zlevněné produkty. • Očekávejte tipy na chytrou elektroniku, aplikace, služby nebo kancelářskou výbavu. • Článek budeme několikrát denně doplňovat a také sledovat, jestli slevy stále platí.</description>

    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Dotykový MacBook Pro si osahali světoví recenzenti. A většinou se vrátili ke klávesnici a trackpadu</title>
      <link>https://www.zive.cz/clanky/dotykovy-macbook-pro-si-osahali-svetovi-recenzenti-avetsinou-se-vratili-ke-klavesnici-a-trackpadu/sc-3-a-244338/default.aspx</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244338-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Apple poprvé vybavil MacBook Pro dotykovým displejem a vsadil na jasný OLED. • Recenzenti chválí obrazovou kvalitu, ale samotný dotyk příliš neoslnil. • Dotykové ovládání trpí stejnými problémy jako u notebooků s Windows.</description>

      <dc:creator>Lukáš Václavík</dc:creator>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Recenze hry Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. Akční blockbuster se zase staví na nohy</title>
      <link>https://doupe.zive.cz/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-recenze-ps5</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244347-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Po rozporuplném Modern Warfare 3 stálo Infinity Ward před nelehkým úkolem. Fanoušci chtěli návrat ke kořenům, silnou kampaň a multiplayer, který nebude působit jako recyklace předchozích ročníků. Modern Warfare 4 dokazuje, že série ještě neřekla poslední slovo. </description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:15:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <dc:creator>Michal Polok</dc:creator>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Levné nákupy z Číny se znovu prodraží. Ke každé položce si teď přičtěte až 5 eur</title>
      <link>https://www.zive.cz/clanky/levne-nakupy-z-ciny-se-znovu-prodrazi-ke-kazde-polozce-si-ted-prictete-az-5-eur/sc-3-a-244341/default.aspx</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244341-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Evropská unie zpřísnila pravidla pro levné zásilky ze zahraničních internetových obchodů. Nové poplatky do jejího rozpočtu přinesou miliardy eur ročně.</description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 9 Nov 2026 13:45:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <dc:creator>Filip Maxa, Živé.sk</dc:creator>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Jak se vyrábějí lži. 30 filmů o manipulaci, kterou neuvidíte, dokud vám ji někdo neukáže</title>
      <link>https://avmania.zive.cz/nejlepsi-filmy-o-lzich-a-manipulacich</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244334-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Lidé často věří, že pravda je jen názor, který má lepší marketing. Jak se vyrábí? Jak přesvědčit miliony lidí, aby uvěřili? Jak se tvoří politické kampaně, manipuluje s veřejným míněním nebo zakrývají miliardové podvody? Vybrali jsme 30 filmů a dokumentů, které odhalují zákulisí politiky, médií, ...</description>
      <pubDate>Sun, 8 Nov 2026 17:45:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <dc:creator>Jaromír Puk</dc:creator>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Čína, mocenské hry a osobní skandál. Šéf Nvidie Jensen Huang se prý zapletl s nepřátelskou špiónkou</title>
      <link>https://www.zive.cz/clanky/cina-mocenske-hry-a-osobni-skandal-sef-nvidie-jensen-huang-se-pry-zapletl-s-nepratelskou-spionkou/sc-3-a-244345/default.aspx</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">244345-zive.cz</guid>
      <description>Americké tajné služby podezírají čínskou podnikatelku ze spolupráce s Pekingem. • Její vztah s šéfem Nvidie nyní prověřuje nezávislé vyšetřování. • Jensen Huang se zároveň omluvil rodině za nevěru.</description>
      <pubDate>Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:45:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <dc:creator>Lukáš Václavík</dc:creator>
    </item>

Akce, která pokud vím, tu dosud neměla obdoby. Celá hala plná několika řad regálů a na nich kytky, spousty kytek. Mnohdy takových, jaké jste ještě nejspíš ani neviděli… A davy, odnášející si mnohdy nejednu plnou tašku. Neuvěřitelný výběr. Plus nějaké doplňky.

Pro mne zjištění, že jsem uvázl v minulosti a jsem mimo nejen v náhledu na ceny v restauracích, ale zaspal jsem i cenový vývoj u pokojovek. Vlastně hrůza, jak velké jmění mi za pár let doma různě uschlo…

Žst. Rumburk:

Moldavská dráha / Teplický Semmering / „Most – Freiberg“ na FB:

V SOBOTU 7. LISTOPADU VYRAZÍ Z DRÁŽĎAN PARNÍ VLAK NA MOLDAVU!

Železniční muzeum Dresden-Altstadt a spolek Flügelradtouristik pořádají mimořádnou jízdu historického vlaku s oddílovými osobními vozy a jídelním vozem.

Z Drážďan vyrazí v 6:30 s německou parní lokomotivou 35 1097 přes Rumburk a Děčín do Mostu. Zde převezme vlak česká parní lokomotiva 433.001 „Skaličák“, které bude na horské trati pomáhat dieselová lokomotiva.

Most 12:00 – Osek město 12:32 – Dubí 13:22 – Moldava 14:09. Zpět z Moldavy vlak odjede v 15:20 přes Dubí, Louku u Litvínova a Teplice do Drážďan. Část historické soupravy zamíří také do Žatce, města chmele a piva.

Souprava na nádraží doplnila vodu (výpomoc poskytly dva vozy JSDH Brtníky), a posádka provedla na mašině nutný servis (trochu mne zaskočily dva pytle písku, ale má to logické vysvětlení).

Na FB Děčínsko video a info:

Parní vlak v čele s německou lokomotivou 35 1097-1 (vyrobenou v roce 1959 a známou také pod přezdívkou Rübezahl) projel v sobotu dopoledne těsně před desátou hodinou po železničním mostě mezi Děčínem východ a hlavním nádražím. Pohled na tuto historickou soupravu z nové lávky pro pěší a cyklisty.

Třetí místo ve futsale vybojovala naše školní reprezentace v dalším dílu seriálu Sportovních her mládeže.

Ve skupině jsme nejprve porazili pozdějšího vítěze, rumburskou obchodku 2:1, když naše góly zařídili Hlavsa a Průša. Poté jsme přesvědčivě zválcovali Mariánskou poměrem 5:0. Trefili se dvakrát Jirků a Hejtmánek, svůj druhý gól v turnaji vsítil také Hlavsa. V posledním zápase nám do finále stačil bod, ovšem trápení v zakončení nebralo konce, a tak jsme s rumburským gymnáziem prohráli 0:2. Čekal nás souboj o bronz s Karolínou Světlou.

V zápase jsme vedli díky dalekonosné střele brankáře Veroňka, avšak Karolínka rychle otočila. V posledních vteřinách nás zachránil Průša a šlo se do penalt. Až v šesté sérii soupeř penaltu neproměnil a naši šestou v řadě dal s přehledem Škvrna.

Děkujeme za vzornou reprezentaci školy této sestavě: Veroněk – Švihlík, Jirků, Průša, Hlavsa, Hejtmánek, Margala, Škvrna.

]]> Okresní kolo ČEPS Cupu – florbal 1. stupeň základních škol (kluci) 2026/2027 https://www.vybezek.eu/296441-okresni-kolo-ceps-cupu-florbal-1-stupen-zakladnich-skol-kluci-2026-2027/ Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:35:41 +0000 https://www.vybezek.eu/?p=296441 Ve středu 4. listopadu 2026 se ve Varnsdorfu ve sportovní hale hrál florbal, proběhlo okresní kolo ČEPS Cupu Děčín-Šluknovsko pro 1. stupeň základních škol (kluci).

Ve středu 4. listopadu 2026 se ve sportovní hale ve Varnsdorfu uskutečnilo okresní kolo florbalového turnaje ČEPS Cupu, určeného pro žáky 1.–5. tříd základních škol.

Turnaj se hrál systémem 3 + 1. Každý tým se utkal s každým soupeřem dvoukolově, přičemž jedno utkání trvalo 2 × 8 minut. Na turnaji se představily tři týmy – ZŠ Východní, Centrum dětí a mládeže Česká Kamenice a naše škola. Každý tým tak odehrál celkem čtyři utkání. Vítězný tým turnaje postoupí do krajského finále.

Hned v úvodním utkání nás čekal nejtěžší soupeř, domácí ZŠ Východní. Po velmi vyrovnaném a bojovném průběhu jsme dokázali zvítězit těsným výsledkem 4:3. Druhý zápas proti soupeři z České Kamenice jsme zvládli výborně a po přesvědčivém výkonu jsme zvítězili 6:2. Ve druhém kole jsme se znovu utkali se ZŠ Východní. Tentokrát nám soupeř porážku oplatil a po dramatickém průběhu jsme prohráli nejtěsnějším rozdílem 2:3. Jelikož i ZŠ Východní zvítězila nad Českou Kamenicí, bylo před závěrečným utkáním jasné, že o vítězi turnaje rozhodne počet vstřelených branek proti tomuto soupeři.

Do závěrečného utkání jsme proto nastoupili s jasnou taktikou – vstřelit co nejvíce branek. Po většinu turnaje nás v brance skvěle držel Adam Reichert, který několika výbornými zákroky podržel tým v nejtěžších chvílích. Pro rozhodující utkání jsme však zvolili odvážný taktický tah. Adama jsme přesunuli z branky do pole, protože sehraná trojice Adam Reichert, Hugo Bláha a Dominik Košín měla za úkol nastřílet co nejvíce gólů. Tento plán dokonale vyšel. Našemu týmu se podařilo zvítězit vysokým rozdílem a vstřelit soupeři 13 branek, tedy o tři více, než dokázala ZŠ Východní. Díky lepšímu skóre jsme se stali vítězi okresního kola a vybojovali si zasloužený postup do krajského finále.

Velkou pochvalu si zaslouží celý tým za bojovnost, nasazení a kolektivní výkon. V našem týmu nastoupila také jediná dívka Barča Šeráková, která byla velmi platnou hráčkou a svým výkonem významně přispěla k celkovému úspěchu. Z individuálních výkonů bych chtěla vyzdvihnout Huga Bláhu, Adama Reicherta, Maxe Zachariáše a Dominika Košína, kteří patřili k oporám našeho týmu. Poděkování však patří všem hráčům za výbornou reprezentaci školy.

Naše sestava: Barča Šeráková, Hugo Bláha, Adam Reichert, Max Zachariáš, Dominik Košín, Adrian Sidorov, Filip Zavadský, Daniel Boleš
